_about: Template: copy this file, fill in every value and its note (_key), then run python -m stackpieces run <your file> --out results/<name>. Values shown are the checkers_rot3u ones as an example.
name: my_pieces

board._square_mm: 8 in board with 1 in squares (checkers project plan, 2026-11-04); Tico measured about 25 mm
board._pieces_on_diagonals_only: checkers: pieces sit on dark squares, so the nearest neighbors are diagonal

piece._diameter_mm: Tico's starting choice: about one square
piece._stack_of: a king is two pieces stacked

gripper._grip_band_min_mm: the fingers need about a 1 cm tall surface (Tico's earlier gripper tests)
gripper._finger_thickness_mm: not measured yet; the finger-room check reports the gap and passes only when this is set
gripper._placement_error: about 1 cm resolution at the end effector before any compensation; uniform = each horizontal axis uniform in +-resolution/2. Alternative: {"model": "gaussian", "sigma_mm": ...}

goal._target_offset: Tico's hope: stack after misalignment up to 50 % (of the diameter here; set target_offset_of to radius for the other reading)
goal._max_height_mm: Tico preferred the shorter design (S40, 22.1 mm) over N35 (28.7 mm); 25 mm separates them
goal._seat_rate_required: used for the 'reliable offset' figure: largest offset with at least this seat rate

printer.name: Bambu X2D, PLA, 0.4 nozzle
printer._layer_mm: preset kit 0.20 functional (Tico's X2D printer rules)
printer._overhang_max_deg: from vertical, unsupported (Tico's X2D printer rules)
printer._min_wall_mm: two lines with a 0.4 nozzle (Tico's X2D printer rules)
printer._hole_undersize_mm: first coupon: holes printed 0.1-0.5 small (diameter); informs the socket clearance
printer._od_undersize_mm: first coupon: round outer shapes about 0.2 small

physics._density: PLA, solid; the settling results do not depend on it
physics._friction_range: static friction between printed PLA parts measured 0.12-0.38 (Effect of the angle of the laid-up filaments on the coefficient of static friction between parts manufactured by extrusion-based 3D printing); 0.2-0.4 used
physics._restitution: low, plastic on plastic; results are insensitive to it at these speeds
physics._release: randomized per release in the Monte Carlo: height uniform, tilt and sideways speed Gaussian (1 sigma). The arm stops before the gripper opens

analysis._analysis: 30 releases give about +-18 percentage points (95 %) at a 50 % rate (+-9 at one sigma)
